newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two Russian children killed in grenade blast.
newsitem.headline: Two Russian children killed in grenade blast.

text.p: Two boys aged five and six were killed when a hand grenade they were playing with exploded in a village in the Voronezh region of central Russia, the Ministry for Emergency Situations said on Monday.
The explosion occurred on Sunday and police suspected the children had picked up the grenade after someone left it on a village street, said a ministry spokesman.
An illegal weapons market is flourishing in Russia where guns and other items are stolen from poorly guarded arms depots.
